title: Musicians around the neighborhood: Benny Carter, Freddie Jenkins
summary: He did not know Benny Carter then, but recalls Freddie Jenkins living nearby and a mystery musician in a big car.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Yeah. Well, what guys did you meet then that you knew afterwards? There were quite a few guys around, no?
No, not too many. Not too many.
No? Was Benny Carter then there?
Or -- is he a little older than you are?
Benny Carter Was he about the same age, I think -- wasn't he the same age as you?
I don't know. I don't know.
But, you didn't know him then?
No, I didn't know him then.
Well, I remember Freddie -- what's his name? Was it Freddie Jenkins?
Jenkins was living down there also, I think.
But there was somebody that I could remember, you see used to come down there in a big car, or something. Like -- a big, expensive car.
Huh? Yeah, I don't know -- I can't remember who it was though.
